usedFor: SuperSaaS holds appointments and users, and Google Sheets stores them as columns through “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A new appointment updates a sheet row, so your schedule view stays current.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” fires on created, changed and deleted appointments alike, so the same row may update more than once.
